summary: Cerebras offers active current Y Combinator companies from any batch a one-time redemption of three months of Tier 1 access to the program’s listed Cerebras Cloud LLMs, valued at up to $22.5K in total subscription cost, not an unrestricted cash or API-credit wallet. The FAQ currently lists Llama 3.3 70b, Llama 8b, Llama 4 Scout, Qwen 3 32B and R1 Llama Distilled 70b, and says models may change as new ones are released. Included benefits are live shared-Slack support and co-marketing opportunities. Apply using the official HubSpot form; no setup fees are advertised.
claim_steps: Confirm that your company is an active current YC company; any batch is eligible, but the offer can be redeemed only once.
Apply using the HubSpot form linked from https://www.cerebras.ai/yc-startup-deal.

If accepted, confirm the three-month Tier 1 model subscriptions, current model list and model-specific rate limits. The advertised up-to-$22.5K is total subscription value, not a general cash balance.

social_proof.title: Cerebras YC Startup Deal
social_proof.text: Get up to $22.5k worth of inference on Cerebras Cloud. Priority support and co-marketing opportunities. YC startups from any batch are eligible. No setup fees, no strings.
